name: Ispánk (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a blue upper hoist part and a white lower fly part, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ispánk: a crowned green shield with a white bird, a bough and a sabre, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed ISPÁNK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Ispánk arms with crown, wreath and scroll
